title_en: Foreign-Trade Zone 62: Penn Aluminum International, LLC; Proposed Production Activity
title_ja: テキサス州の外国貿易地域におけるアルミ管製造計画の公告
facts_ja: 外国貿易地域委員会は、押出・引抜加工のコイル状アルミ管（原文記載税率は無税）を製造し、外国ステータスのアルミビレット（同50％）を使う提案を公告。提案の承認・税率変更は未確認。

DEPARTMENT OF COMMERCE

Foreign-Trade Zones Board

[B-143-2026]

Foreign-Trade Zone (FTZ) 62, Notification of Proposed Production Activity; Penn

Aluminum International, LLC; (Extruded and Drawn Coiled Aluminum Tubing);

Harlingen, Texas

        Penn Aluminum International, LLC submitted a notification of proposed

production activity to the FTZ Board (the Board) for its facility in Harlingen, Texas within

FTZ 62. The notification conforming to the requirements of the Board’s regulations (15

CFR 400.22) was received on October 13, 2026.

        Pursuant to 15 CFR 400.14(b), FTZ production activity would be limited to the

specific foreign-status material(s)/component(s) and specific finished product(s)

described in the submitted notification (summarized below) and subsequently

authorized by the Board. The benefits that may stem from conducting production activity

under FTZ procedures are explained in the background section of the Board’s website –

accessible via www.trade.gov/ftz.

        The proposed finished product is extruded and drawn coiled aluminum tubing

(duty-free).

        The proposed foreign-status material/component is aluminum billets (duty rate

50%).

        The request indicates that aluminum billets are subject to duties under section

232 of the Trade Expansion Act of 1962 and section 301 of the Trade Act of 1974,

depending on the country of origin. The applicable section 232 and section 301

decisions require subject merchandise to be admitted to FTZs in privileged foreign

status (19 CFR 146.41). The Board’s regulations (15 CFR 400.13(c)(2)) require that
